master: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character animation source sheet for Demian. Input image 1 is the identity reference for ARSAL. Input image 2 shows the existing game's sprite art style and sheet format; use its polished chibi game illustration style, but ONLY depict Arsal. Generate a transparent RGBA sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, exactly 8 columns and 5 rows, 40 separate full-body Arsal figures. Equal invisible cells, every figure contained in its cell with generous empty transparent gutter. Same character proportions and head scale throughout: young man, neatly slicked-back black hair with side part, small neat black moustache, warm light-olive skin, large dark eyes, charcoal black collared long-sleeve shirt tucked into black trousers, black belt and black shoes, narrow patterned gold/burgundy/beige necktie. Back of shirt has small cream retro arcade alien with RETRO MIND lettering if possible. No extra accessories. Match provided Arsal facial identity and outfit. Row 1 eight idle turnarounds in exact order: front, front-left, left profile, back-left, back, back-right, right profile, front-right. Row 2: eight subtle breathing idle poses facing right/front-right, hands relaxed, feet grounded. Row 3: eight successive WALK cycle keyframes facing right, complete slow gait with alternating legs, feet do not cross into neighbor cells. Row 4: eight successive JUMP keyframes facing right: knee bend, push-off, rising, tucked airborne, apex, descending, feet extending, standing landing. Row 5: eight successive friendly celebration poses facing front-right: relaxed, raise right hand, wave, smile, V sign, hold V sign, lower hand, relaxed. Clean high-quality dark outlines and softly shaded pixel-inspired chibi art consistent with the reference style. NO captions, no borders, no background, no ground shadows, no duplicates merged together, no scene or poster. Strict uniform scale, full-body and disconnected separate figures on actual transparent background. Preserve moustache and patterned tie in every forward or side pose.
motion: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Demian 2D game sprite animation source sheet. Image 1 is Arsal identity reference, image 2 is his approved source sprite sheet. Generate the SAME Arsal with identical face, black slicked-back parted hair, small black moustache, charcoal-black button shirt, black belt, black trousers and shoes, narrow burgundy/gold/beige patterned necktie, same polished chibi proportions and art style. Output landscape 1536x1024 RGBA with ACTUAL fully transparent background, alpha=0 for all space between characters; no brown haze, no backdrop, no ground or shadows. Exactly 8 columns x 3 rows, 24 distinct separate full-body poses evenly spaced with generous gutters. Row 1: first complete eight-keyframe RUN cycle facing RIGHT, grounded stride, toe-off, leading high knee, airborne split legs, contact, passing leg, opposite split legs, return. Row 2: second complete eight-keyframe RUN cycle facing RIGHT, alternating legs and arms, continuous looping run at same scale. Row 3: eight LANDING recovery poses facing right: full-height standing reference pose, knees bending on contact, lowest soft knee bend, rise from knee bend, settling upright, upright breathing, relaxed standing, relaxed standing reference. Keep head and body scale identical in all 24 poses. Necktie sways naturally during run but no superpowers. No text, no headers, no borders, no scene, no shadows. Preserve identity faithfully. Each character silhouette must be separate; no overlapping cells. Match the head/body ratio of image 2.
slide: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D game LOW SLIDE animation source sheet for Demian. Reference 1 defines Arsal identity; reference 2 defines his exact approved chibi sprite style. Generate precisely 8 separate full-body poses in a grid of 4 columns by 2 rows on a true fully transparent RGBA background. Same young Arsal, slicked-back black side-parted hair, small neat black moustache, light olive skin and dark eyes, black collared tucked shirt and belt, black trousers and black shoes, narrow patterned burgundy/beige/gold tie. IDENTICAL facial identity, head/body proportions and costume throughout. All eight figures face RIGHT and all are a very LOW ground slide under a low obstacle: torso leaned back at about 25 degrees above horizontal, hips almost on the ground, one leg extended straight forward and the other bent low, arms tucked or hand touching ground. Top of head is no higher than 60 percent of his standing height at the same head size. This is a low baseball-style seated sliding movement, NOT kneeling or upright crouching. Row 1 shows successive low sliding poses with legs and trailing tie shifting slightly; row 2 continues the same very low slide, full cycle, every frame remains low and never stands. Constant head scale, gently varying limbs, 4 equal invisible columns, 2 equal invisible rows, generous transparent gutters, all body parts fully inside cells. Landscape 1536x1024. Crisp dark outlines, polished softly shaded pixel-inspired chibi illustration as reference 2. NO text, captions, background, colored haze, ground shadows, dust, effects, borders, crop, overlap, weapons, or extra characters. Actual alpha-zero space around figures.
